items.pageDescription:
ParentPay Group is Europe's leading EdTech provider, with twelve brands providing digital solutions for MIS, Payments, Catering, Finance, Communication, Facilities Hire and Reading Solutions in schools and higher education.

I am the lead designer, producing all designed assets across the business, with occassional support from freelancers.

items.title: robPezetPottery
items.name: Rob Pezet Pottery
items.pageDescription:
Rob Pezet Pottery is a boutique pottery studio based in Bristol.

Rob wanted an identity he could use on his social media and business cards when attending markets.

Together, we came up with an earthy colour palette, fun logo and a freehand drawing style that can be adapted across assets.

In the future, he intends to expand into website design.

items.title: cardiffBookshopMap
items.name: Cardiff Bookshop Map
items.pageDescription:
Cardiff Bookshop Map is produced by Yellow Back Books alongside writer and editor Hati Gibson. The project was developed as part of Gibson's Yellow Back Books residency at Arcade Campfa. The map is an A2 folded format.

The Cardiff Bookshop Map is a not-for-profit project offering greater visibility to Cardiff's independent bookshops and reading rooms. The map was available physically (in 2022) from ArcadeCampfa and independent bookshops across Cardiff.
acknowledgements: In collaboration with: Arcade Campfa and Yellow Back Books

items.title: savillsPrivateOffice
items.name: Savills Private Office
items.pageDescription:
Savills Private Office helps high and ultra-high net worth individuals gain access to comprehensive, tailored and confidential real estate.

Produced within creative agency, Uncommonly, these email templates worked with an exisiting website produced for The Private Office. The result was a streamlined, continuous look across all marketing assets.
acknowledgements: In collaboration with: Arcade Campfa and Yellow Back Books

items.title: vaniday
items.name: Vaniday
items.pageDescription:
Vaniday is the online platform to browse and book beauty & wellness services.

Design work spanned all areas of the business, in three languages and five markets.

Digital design included designing multi-weekly email campaigns, app banners, landing pages and Instagram posts (both inspirational and promotional).

Print design included flyers and posters.

I was the lead designer on the Vaniday Home campaign, tasked with creating a sub-brand and campaign identity.
captions: A selection of social design for the markets in UAE, and Brasil
Some email designs for the Brasillian and Italian markets
A selection of email campaign designs including a partnership with Dove

items.title: calibreAudio
items.name: Calibre Audio
items.pageDescription:
Calibre Audio is a national charity providing a collection of over 15,000 audiobooks for anyone who finds it difficult to read print.

Calibre Audio asked me to help them design their 2022-2023 Impact Report.

items.title: birthstone
items.name: Birthstone Generator
items.pageDescription:
This birthstone generator uses the select function to display your birth month and associated birthstone. The project is based on an initial challenge by Front End Mentor which I repurposed.

I designed the UI, 3D modelled the gems using Blender and incorporated Javascript for functionality.
skills: HTML/CSS, Javascript, Web Design, 3D Design using Blender
